Name: NPC Map Locations for Android
Author: Priff13
Description:
All credits go to the original creators of the mod at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239?tab=posts]NPC Map Locations[/url].
﻿Simply adjusts the size of the map in the menu as to not extend beyond the bounds of the menu.

Minimap feature available through rebinding the MinimapToggleKey (found in config/globals.json) with the Virtual Keyboard Mod.
Minimap can also be enabled by setting "ShowMinimap": true in config/globals.json.

Manifest.Name: NPC Map Locations for Android
Manifest.Description: Shows NPCs and farmers on a modified map page for accurate tracking. Now modified for Android by Priff13. Based on NPCMapLocations version 3.2.1 by Bouhm.
